Our Solutions

Comprehensive Security Hardware & Systems

We source, install, and configure genuine products built for high durability, weatherproofing, and seamless integration.

IP & HD Cameras

Hikvision & Dahua Dome, Bullet, and Eyeball cameras featuring IP67 weather-resistance, vandal proofing, and up to 4K resolution.

Features: ColorVu / AcuSense / IR Night Vision

360° PTZ Speed Domes

Pan-Tilt-Zoom cameras offering 25x-42x optical zoom for wide area coverage, auto-tracking targets, and long-range laser IR illuminators.

Ideal for: Large Estates / Warehouses / Parking Yards

Biometrics & Access Control

ZKTeco and Hikvision facial recognition terminals, fingerprint readers, RFID door cards, and turnstile integrations with time & attendance tracking.

Features: Touchless AI Face ID / Time Logs

NVRs, DVRs & Storage

4-channel up to 128-channel Network Video Recorders (NVR) with RAID storage, dual-power redundancy, and off-site cloud backups.

Tech: H.265+ Zip Compression / Western Digital Purple HDDs

Video Intercoms & Gate Control

IP Video Door Stations allowing you to speak to visitors and remotely unlock gates via indoor touchscreens or your smartphone.

Ideal for: Apartments / Villas / Executive Offices

Perimeter Intrusion Alarms

Infrared photo-electric beams, motion sensors, electric fence controllers, and loud siren strobe integrations for real-time deterrence.

Features: Instant SMS & App Alerts / Siren Trigger

Our Installation Process

We follow strict engineering standards to ensure zero blind spots, clean cabling, and long-term system stability.

01

Site Assessment

We survey your property to map out key risk areas, lighting conditions, and blind spots.

02

System Design

We recommend exact camera models (Dahua/Hikvision) and storage capacities to fit your budget.

03

Precision Wiring

Our technicians perform tidy CAT6/Coaxial trunking, camera mounting, and power backups.

04

Setup & Training

We configure mobile apps for live viewing and train your security team on operating the NVR.
